notes.title: Update version 1.7.0
notes.content:
Here is a list of the updates:

- added enemy spaceman
- added damage for explosions
- new black hole sprite
- h2o drains slower
- improved  ice blinking effect
- centered mouse cursor correctly
- adjusted achievements
- improved wreckage in radar view
- select random song when open application

notes.title: Version 1.6.0
notes.content:
based on a video review I have made a few changes to this game. 
- added spinning black hole sprite to make black hole more visible.
- lowered death sound volume
- made ice and grenades a little bigger
- added death reason to game over page
- removed background for game over on screen
- added song selection header text in options
- slowed asteroid spin
- edited background graphics
- adjusted effects
